notes: Paper trading action fix: if an entire paper scan has no normal BUY, Scout can place one small paper-only fallback BUY in the best candidate that is not hard-blocked. Higher paper risk may bypass soft quality misses only; hard safety failures still block. Paper positions also get risk-adjusted time exits so continuous mode cycles through BUY/HOLD/SELL instead of becoming HOLD-only. LIVE never uses the fallback or paper time-exit paths.
